_about: Hand-kept table of Canadian official port status for /ships (docs/OFFICIAL_PORT_LISTS.md, plan approved by Josh 2026-09-27). Each row cites the pages it comes from; scripts/ships/import-official-ports.mjs fetches those pages, stores them as evidence (source 'ca-official-ports', kind web_page) and accepts a row only when its `check` text appears in every cited page. `wpi` = the World Port Index port numbers the row applies to (stable keys; our port ids differ between databases). The WPI crosswalk is EarthAtlas's interpretation (the plan's list), not a statement by Transport Canada: the pages give names and status, not port limits as geometry. Checked 2026-09-27.
